title: The board stays on this machine unless asked, with a key you can rotate
summary: The board listens on 127.0.0.1 by default; board.host: network binds every address, its link on the address found at each start, the 127.0.0.1 link kept (no network: 127.0.0.1, said so); a fixed address only via --host; board --new-key rotates the key (done 2026-11-21); cookie 30 days.
